caption: why do these zombies have NAMES 😶
logline: A player kid in a hamlet where every villager wears a name tag watches three named zombies walk out of the woods every night, until the night Mom goes to visit the neighbors 'in the city' and four walk out.
question: why tf do these zombies have name tags?
premise: Every villager in Milo's hamlet at the edge of a dark oak forest gets a name tag at birth. Mom's says ROSA. Milo is the only player. Every night three zombies named TOMAS, GRETA and OLD BEN walk out of the woods, stop at the hamlet's fence and stare at Mom. Mom says the zombies stole the tags, and that the neighbors (three empty cottages with those names on their signs) moved to the city. Every week Mom, the hamlet's cleric, takes them a golden apple and a splash potion ('potion, then apple, fixes anything') and brings it all back unused, so Milo gets the apples. Nobody in the hamlet can throw anything, so Milo wins every egg fight. Tonight Mom goes to visit Tomas and says she'll be back by dark.
twist: The zombies are the neighbors, converted in a siege: a named villager keeps its name tag (and its profession outfit) when a zombie converts it. Mom has been trying to cure them every week with the vanilla cure (a splash potion of weakness, then a golden apple), but only a player can throw a splash potion and feed the apple, and villagers can't throw. She lied so her son, the one person who could do it, would never go into the woods. Tonight she stays out past dark: four zombies walk out and the first tag says ROSA, still holding the golden apple. She drops the potion on the path, Milo picks it up, and with a hotbar full of the apples she gave him he throws: potion, then apple.

world.place: a cleric's hamlet of seven cottages on a slope at the east edge of a dark oak forest, one valley west of the carpeted village (Light Sleeper)
world.easter_egg: S02: as the crane rises and looks east over the hamlet, the carpeted village of Light Sleeper sits on the far hill in the haze: red and orange carpet roofs and the white wool box of its bell. Provisional: re-check against docs/world/canon.md when it lands.

Mom.on_screen: a plains cleric villager (purple robe), name tag ROSA always visible; holds a golden apple over her crossed arms (S06, S07, S10); the splash potion goes into her inventory in S06 (her off hand: villagers don't show it). After the reveal: a zombie villager in the same purple cleric robe, tag ROSA, the golden apple in her right hand and the splash potion in her left (conversion keeps both hands) until she drops it in S13. One voiced line (L05), on screen, in her own request.

lines.text: Potion, / then APPLE, / she says. / Fixes ANYTHING.

Nobody here / can THROW. / I win every / EGG FIGHT.

lines.text: At dark, / FOUR zombies / walked out.

lines.text: Mom lied / to keep me HOME. / She can't THROW.
lines.direction: figuring it out as he says it
brave and certain, loud, a wind-up on the first two words

beats: S15 (POV): on 'I CAN' the arm winds up, ROSA 3.5 blocks ahead by the lamp post, the apple in her hand; on 'Potion' the splash potion leaves the hand and shatters on her (glass break, the grey-purple Weakness splash and swirl): the payoff hit.
On 'APPLE' the hotbar selection slides from the emptied slot 3 to slot 2, golden apples x7, and 'Golden Apple' pops above the hotbar. TOMAS, GRETA and OLD BEN stand further up the meadow behind her.
Cut at most 1 s after 'APPLE'. No completed cure: the line has just said the next step.
ending.loop: cause and effect: L01's three named zombies are the neighbors Mom couldn't cure, and the kid who wins every egg fight is the only one who can.
